bunQuestion.answer: NO — the packer needs nothing on PATH that the job does not already have. `actions/setup-node` with node 24 IS the whole toolchain, so NO setup-bun step was added.
bunQuestion.why: scripts/pack-mpd.ts spawns exactly ONE child process, `spawnSync(process.execPath, ...)` (verifyValidatorEntry), i.e. the node already running it. The `[pack-mpd] validator:` line is a GENERATED sidecar: writeValidatorEntry() reads the committed `packages/mpd-ext-plugin/dist/index.js` and appends the VALIDATOR_SHIM_EXPORTS re-export block as text — never a `bun build`. The `.toolchain` -> `<baseUrl>/node_modules/.bin/*` rewrites were REMOVED in wave 2 (B8), so no `.toolchain` binary is consulted either. A `dist/validator.js` built by the package itself would win, and that file is NOT committed (generated at pack time), which is why the local and CI routes both generate.
bunQuestion.evidence: measured twice with bun scrubbed from PATH: on the working tree (exit 0, 608 files) and on a TRACKED-FILES-ONLY tree with no dist/mpd-package (exit 0, 606 files) — see pack-mpd-workspace.log and pack-mpd-checkout-tree-nobun.log.
